protocol.baseline_selection_validation: CSV omits indices; only declared feasibility, capacity totals, value bounds, trial identities and hashes' format are verifiable
protocol.bootstrap: paired percentile 95% CI conditional on trained models; whole real dates across cells, synthetic instances within family/n/alpha cells; equal source means in each draw
protocol.bootstrap_delta: DQN exact gap minus greedy exact gap, percentage points; lower is better
protocol.dqn_mean: arithmetic mean across seeds 0, 1, 2; win/tie/loss average per-seed rates
protocol.e4b: main-test subset; strict quantity_w or original UnitPrice above training 99th percentile, joined by source_row_ids
protocol.e4b_and_e3_dependence: E4b overlaps E1; E3 may reuse test source rows/dates; intervals are suite-specific, not independent studies
protocol.infeasible: retained and counted as failures; quality is reported as recorded and must be interpreted with feasibility
protocol.latency: pooled observed single-solution calls; random per trial; DQN mean pools single-run seed timings descriptively, not ensemble cost
protocol.median: weighted empirical median with equal represented-source mass; DQN mean row takes the median of per-instance seed averages, not the mean of per-seed medians
protocol.primary_weighting: equal source means for E1/E3; synthetic only E4; real only E4b
protocol.quality: normalized_quality = V / fractional upper_bound U; exact_quality = V / certified V*; exact gap = 100*(1-exact_quality)
protocol.random: arithmetic mean of 10 trials within each instance, never best-of-ten
protocol.training_seed_sd: sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of three source-balanced seed estimates
protocol.trivial: counted; excluded from percentage denominators; a source with no eligible denominator makes its mixed percentage undefined, and such bootstrap draws are skipped and counted
